correctness.rationale: Six edge-direction length parameters satisfy p1-q1=p2-q2=p3-q3, giving exactly five Minkowski-indecomposable atoms S1,S2,S3,T+,T-. For kH, full atomic decompositions D_t (k-t copies each segment and t copies each triangle) have 3k-t summands, t=0..k. Any common coarsening of D_t,D_u has attainable triangle counts in integer interval [B,B+sum mu_j], hence the explicitly constructed finest common coarsening D_(t,u) has 3k-2u+t summands; extremes of any index set control its reduced intersection. Applying Filip 2026 pair-base correspondence yields k+1 components and reduced intersection dimension 3k-2b+a. Independently solved all atomic edge-length equations through k=8, matching k+1 solutions; finite checks do not prove general k.
